evals.name: morning-brief-one-dominant-story
evals.prompt: put together a morning brief on this week's sanctions news for me
evals.expected_output: Triggers. Picks top-story-digest, states the choice in one line, reads only reference/top-story-digest.md. Lead item gets full Smart Brevity treatment; 3-6 digest items of equal length, each with its own why-it-matters and a link.

evals.name: flat-week-no-dominant-story
evals.prompt: five things worth reading on the Baltic this week, nothing huge happened
evals.expected_output: Triggers. Picks curated-list rather than forcing a lead item. Flat, equal-length items, no connective prose between them, every item linked and headlined in its own words.

evals.name: explainer-request-by-name
evals.prompt: write this up as an explainer, people keep asking me what the new export regime actually is
evals.expected_output: Triggers. Picks explainer-faq, not smart-brevity. Question headline, one-sentence standfirst answer, sub-heads phrased as real questions, each section answering in its first sentence and readable out of order.

evals.name: breaking-news-wire-copy
evals.prompt: the council just adopted the package, write it up straight, 400 words
evals.expected_output: Triggers. Picks inverted-pyramid. One-sentence lede carrying the outcome, descending importance, attribution in the first two paragraphs, no section headings, no closing flourish.

evals.name: format-named-explicitly
evals.prompt: do the summit piece in Smart Brevity
evals.expected_output: Triggers. The named format overrides the picker table. Reads reference/smart-brevity.md only. Axiom headline of six words or fewer, Why it matters that is not a restatement, optional blocks cut rather than padded.

evals.name: trend-with-a-person
evals.prompt: I've interviewed four customs brokers who are turning away clients. There's a piece in this, can you draft it
evals.expected_output: Triggers. Picks anecdotal-lede. Opens on one named real broker for 2-3 paragraphs, nut graf lands by paragraph four, includes a counter-case, returns to the opening person at the end.

evals.name: postmortem-with-timeline
evals.prompt: reconstruct how the tanker monitoring failed that night, I have the full timeline
evals.expected_output: Triggers. Picks martini-glass. Narrative section carries no analysis or foreshadowing, a short distinct turn, then analysis and implications shorter than the narrative, plus an accountability paragraph.

evals.name: near-miss-search-not-format
evals.prompt: find me the latest on the summit
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger. This is a collection request; news-search handles it. No format is picked and no reference file is read.

evals.name: near-miss-line-level-rewrite
evals.prompt: this draft sounds like it was written by a bot, clean it up
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger. Structure is not the problem; humanizer owns the line-level pass. Does not restructure the piece into a skeleton.

evals.name: near-miss-deck-not-article
evals.prompt: turn the sanctions briefing into a deck for Thursday
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger. frontend-slides owns presentations. Does not produce an article skeleton or a newsletter.

evals.name: near-miss-verification
evals.prompt: is it true that 28 of the listed firms are intermediaries?
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger. fact-check owns claim verification. No format selection occurs.
